chapter_meta_description: Han Li stands at a crossroads. After his trials on land, he sets his sights on the vast and lawless Chaotic Star Sea. A new world of pirates, sea monsters, and ancient secrets awaits.
og_title: Chapter 574: Setting Sail for the Chaotic Star Sea
og_description: The Mortal Stream expands! Han Li does what he does best: takes stock of his gains, makes a cold calculation, and chooses his next deadly battlefield.
twitter_description: A new chapter of adventure begins as Han Li prepares to leave the mortal world behind for the dangers of the Chaotic Star Sea. #MortalJourney

lore_anchors.definition: A legendary cultivation technique inspired by the Kun Peng, a mythical creature from Daoist literature that transforms from a giant fish into a celestial bird, symbolizing immense scale and transformative power.
A school of cultivation that prioritizes rapid power gains, often using cruel or taboo methods, contrasting with the more "orthodox" sects.
